Hello LAVAAN members

Network Psychometrics: From Theory to Practice led by Larry Price (University of Texas Health Science Center San Antonio, Long School of Medicine) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This workshop introduces network psychometrics, offering a novel approach to understanding psychological constructs through network models. For researchers engaged in latent variable analysis, often using packages like lavaan, these methods provide a powerful complementary lens to explore the intricate relationships and structures within their data. The seminar's focus on network-based factor analysis, construct validation, and model invariance assessment will directly equip participants to enhance the robustness and interpretability of their existing measurement models.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
